entries.0b5a3f463a265f32: This involves supplying electricity from thermal power generation, nuclear power generation and others. For the company on a non-consolidated basis in the fiscal year ended March 2026, its own power generation was 56,168 million kWh, of which thermal was 43,201 million kWh, hydro was 7,716 million kWh and nuclear was 5,199 million kWh (nuclear power was 229.4% of the previous year). As initiatives, the company increased the output of Unit 1 of the Joetsu Thermal Power Station from 572,000 kilowatts to 599,000 kilowatts and continued the safe and stable operation of Unit 2 of the Onagawa Nuclear Power Station. Revenue for this category alone is not printed in the filing.

entries.31cd3976dad1330e: This reportable segment provides neutral and fair electricity network services. The company's general transmission and distribution business and its power generation and other businesses on remote islands were succeeded by Tohoku Electric Power Network Co., Ltd. through an absorption-type company split in April 2020. In the fiscal year ended March 2026, revenue from external customers was ¥476,702 million. Revenue before elimination of internal transactions was ¥921.3 billion, a decrease of ¥24.5 billion (2.6%) from the previous period. Although revenue from standard wheeling charges rose owing to revisions to unit wheeling charges, revenue from supply-demand adjustment fell, among other factors. Area electricity demand was 75.2 billion kWh, roughly the same as the previous period. As initiatives, the company is pursuing efficiency measures in response to rising prices and other factors, reducing procurement costs for adjustment capacity, efficiently building, renewing and operating transmission and distribution facilities, and strengthening cooperation with local governments and disaster prevention organizations.

entries.6610768433ac6992: This category is placed outside the reportable segments and includes the general facilities engineering business, real estate business, DX/IT business and others. From the fiscal year ended March 2026, the business segment classification has been revised into 6 categories: 'Power Generation and Sales Business,' 'Transmission and Distribution Business,' 'General Facilities Engineering Business,' 'Real Estate Business,' 'DX/IT Business' and 'Other Businesses,' and the figures for the previous year have also been restated to the new classification. In the fiscal year ended March 2026, revenue from external customers was ¥52,279 million (¥108,392 million in the previous year). Revenue before elimination of internal transactions was ¥181.6 billion, a decrease of ¥93 billion (33.9%) from the previous period. The reasons include Yuatec Co., Ltd. changing from a consolidated subsidiary to an equity-method affiliate. Because it is not a reportable segment, it is placed last rather than in order of revenue.

entries.9040d45eb6869416: This reportable segment provides a stable supply of electricity from thermal, nuclear and renewable energy sources, provides services that use renewable energy, and provides electricity retail and solution services; corporate and indirect functions are also included here. In the fiscal year ended March 2026, revenue from external customers was ¥1,843,438 million, one of the larger figures among the reportable segments. Revenue before elimination of internal transactions was ¥1,981.7 billion, a decrease of ¥219.7 billion (10.0%) from the previous period. The main reason is a decrease in retail electricity sales volume, among other factors. The company's electricity sales volume was 58.2 billion kWh in retail (down 4.4% from the previous period), 20.6 billion kWh in wholesale (up 20.5%), and 78.9 billion kWh in total (up 1.1%).

entries.eebceff501927ab8: This business covers power generation from renewable energy, next-generation energy and green energy. In the fiscal year ended March 2026, the company newly participated in 2 wind power projects that are in commercial operation. If all development projects are commercialized, the equity-share output of renewable energy will be about 900,000 kilowatts in cumulative total as of the end of fiscal 2025. In June 2025, the company began commercial operation of the Nirazuka Battery Storage Station (Isesaki City, Gunma Prefecture) and the Kozunoda Battery Storage Station (Ota City, Gunma Prefecture) as its grid-scale battery storage business. Revenue for this category alone is not printed in the filing.
